amp_skip_interpretation.cross_arm_interpretation: report realized completed updates and skip counts per arm; equal attempt budgets do not imply equal realized optimizer updates when skip counts differ
amp_skip_interpretation.per_epoch_validity: optimizer_attempts equals the recipe count; completed_updates and amp_skipped_updates are nonnegative; completed_updates plus amp_skipped_updates equals optimizer_attempts; completed_updates is positive
amp_skip_interpretation.policy: GradScaler skips are recorded outcomes, not an automatic fit rejection

authorization.fit: disabled until an exact root conditional-fit receipt is embedded
authorization.grading: root-owned; only the frozen 468-group evaluation population is exported
authorization.provider_push: pending root packet review and fresh quota admission

comparison_scope.all_data_teacher_family: not tested by this clean-fold capacity pair
comparison_scope.claim_scope: bounded clean-fold fit screen; not a public-score forecast or submission claim
comparison_scope.pairing: same seed-9 initialization protocol, ordered clean-fold fit pools, seeded epoch order, B8, loss, clipping, schedule, precision and four epochs; independent fresh model and optimizer per process
comparison_scope.profile_reuse: reuse only the successful actual V4 full-shape B8 Muon profiles; do not rerun profiles
comparison_scope.selection_policy: valid local/cloud cross-validation is the primary model-selection evidence; public evaluation is confirmation, and a public mismatch alone does not automatically kill a direction

fit_and_export_gate.artifact_delivery: checkpoint, fit/provenance receipts with raw attempt/completed/skip counters and their validator interpretation, periodic loss-sample summary, prediction array and sidecar are required per arm; each arm is independently preserved if its pair mate fails
fit_and_export_gate.fit: fresh seed-9 initialization; exactly four epochs; fixed epoch-3 checkpoint; no profile rerun; B8 has 1492 outer batches per epoch and ten optimizer updates per batch
fit_and_export_gate.prediction_export: FP32 feature-only inference on exactly the frozen 468 clean-fold evaluation groups; no labels or scoring masks are read; no score is computed in the worker
fit_and_export_gate.strict_fit_contract: exact per-epoch attempt and completed-batch counts; nonnegative AMP skips accepted only when completed updates plus skips exactly equal attempts and completed updates are positive; finite checkpoint tensors, all periodic fit-loss log samples finite and complete, finite FP32 predictions, same frozen split/membership/sampler receipts and exact command arguments in both arms

fit_membership.source: train+valid through the frozen clean fold-0 component split

initialization: fresh seed-9 initialization; no checkpoint, teacher, or teammate weights

input_cache_repair.admission: after hashing, remeasure cgroup current/maximum/available and system MemAvailable in the actual Kaggle runner inventory; preserve the existing host RAM reservation gate and reject before worker launch if capacity is insufficient
input_cache_repair.effect_claim: advice is a kernel hint and does not establish that pages were evicted
input_cache_repair.repair: during each required full SHA-256 fallback, advise only already-read page-aligned windows of the same exact mounted regular file with POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED; use 64 MiB windows and persist bounded progress/memory receipts every 1 GiB
input_cache_repair.scope: exactly the two raw parquet and four frozen fold0 cache paths named by portable_inputs.json; no copied data, path discovery, or unrelated file advice

inputs.mount_use: Raw train/valid come from the approved raw dataset. Only the four named fold0 cache files are linked from the reusable asset mount. Other model/teacher files in that mount are not read. One read-only mounted copy is shared by every arm.

objective.loss: weighted MSE on two primary targets
objective.weight: absolute magnitude of the clipped target

optimizer.adamw_control: torch AdamW on all trainable parameters; same LR, WD and OneCycle schedule

muon.other_parameters: project AdamW update for input projection, head, and biases
muon.policy: FP32 Newton-Schulz matrix products except native CUDA BF16 when compute capability major >= 8 and torch.cuda.is_bf16_supported() both hold. This is independent of the model's FP16 autocast and GradScaler. T4/P100 use FP32.
muon.scope: GRU weight_ih_l* and weight_hh_l* only; three separate GRU gate blocks

profile.actual_cli_note: The trainer supports --profile-warmup and --profile-steps; it does not support the older V1 draft's --profile-trace-output token, which is intentionally absent.
profile.precision_note: The trainer command used FP16 autocast with GradScaler init scale 4096. OPTIMIZER_COMPUTE_PRECISION.selected_dtype records Muon orthogonalization dtype separately; the measured T4 policy selected FP32 orthogonalization.
required_evidence: actual V4 PROFILE and PROFILE_UPDATE_EVIDENCE from the exact archived trainer
230 attempts, 230 completed updates, 0 AMP skips and 230 loss checks per required arm
actual V4 argv records bind FP16 autocast, GradScaler scale 4096, B8, 3 warmup and 20 timed batches
finite profile losses and gradients with GradScaler enabled
Muon orthogonalization precision metadata matches the declared hardware policy; it is distinct from model autocast precision
stable one-device T4 identity, positive finite timing, measured GPU memory and host headroom

profile_evidence.profile_status: both actual B8 profiles completed 230 updates with zero skips; V4 failed only in its post-profile consumer and did not fit either arm

profile_projection.admission: require actual two-T4 and host 4-CPU/16-GiB simultaneous-worker preflight for the pair; each worker is allocated 2 CPU threads, using the observed dual-T4 host's full 4-CPU affinity
profile_projection.basis: actual V4 full-shape PROFILE median outer-sequence-batch wall time measured with 4 CPU threads per arm; B8 has 1492 batches per epoch, ten chunk updates per batch, four epochs, and 1.20 safety multiplier. V5R3 shares the observed 4-CPU host across two workers at 2 threads each, so this is a projection reference, not a timing guarantee.
profile_projection.source: V4 root-reviewed profile evidence manifest and logs, preserved unchanged under producer_evidence/v4

runtime.cpu_allocation_change: V4 profile timings used 4 CPU threads per arm; this fit-only successor uses 2 threads per arm so both independently bound T4 workers fit the measured 4-CPU Kaggle host. Fit wall projections are not guaranteed under this shared CPU allocation.
runtime.initial_execution_scope: fixed-B8 fit-only; reuse reviewed V4 profiles, with no profile rerun
runtime.physical_devices: one UUID-bound physical T4 per independent arm process
runtime.provider: Kaggle with actual Tesla T4 device identities measured at startup
runtime.root_fit_authorization: required and hash-bound; no implicit fallback or profile-only authorization

sampler.drop_last_disclosure: B8 selects all 11940 fit groups but consumes 11936 per epoch (4 not consumed); B4 consumes all 11940. The worker records counts and seed/epoch provenance. It does not claim an exact dropped group identity because the trainer does not persist the realized batch row-group sequence.
sampler.historical_comparison_limit: H232 used PyTorch RandomSampler/global CPU RNG. This explicit seeded sampler is a declared change, so this is not a pure width-only replay of historical H232.
sampler.implementation: EpochOrderSampler with independent torch.Generator per epoch
sampler.pairing: All arms use the same ordered fit pools, seed, batch size, drop_last and epoch seed; the sampler does not consume model-initialization global RNG.

scientific_question: At fixed seed, clean-fold membership, B8 objective and four-epoch budget, does the independently implemented Muon recurrent update support a useful GRU width ladder from 512 to 768?

source.build_scope: reuse the byte-identical V5R2 source archive, trainer, optimizer, input closure, membership, profiles, objective and CLI; V5R3 changes only fit-artifact validation to distinguish attempts, completed updates and valid GradScaler skips, and records finite periodic trainer loss samples

training.amp_skip_gate: Accept nonnegative GradScaler skips only when completed updates plus skips equal the exact attempt count and at least one update completes; persist counts for interpretation.
training.batch_selection_rule: Fixed B8 for both fit arms, selected by the two completed actual V4 B8 profiles. V5R3 performs no profile rerun and has no batch or single-arm fallback.
